title: Global mean conservation for 2D periodic scalar advection surrogates
transformation_preconditions: The scalar field is defined on a periodic Cartesian grid.
The one-step transport operator is conservative under periodic wrapping.
The metric is evaluated on the scalar field without masking or boundary cropping.

boundary_condition_compatibility.reason: Periodic advection preserves the spatial integral of the scalar field.

output_mapping.description: Compare the spatial mean of the source input and the SUT output after one predicted advection step.

exclusion_rules: Exclude source fields with vanishing RMS below the numeric guard.
Exclude SUTs whose inference path is nondeterministic.

verdict_interpretation.pass: The observed predicted step preserved the spatial mean under the declared tolerance.
verdict_interpretation.fail: The observed predicted step exceeded the declared mean-drift tolerance.
verdict_interpretation.skip: The run was not executed because prerequisites were absent or disabled.
verdict_interpretation.out-of-relation-domain: The source case did not satisfy periodic advection preconditions.
verdict_interpretation.numerical-tolerance-issue: The result was dominated by numeric precision or calibration uncertainty.
verdict_interpretation.inconclusive: The run did not provide enough evidence for pass/fail classification.

claim_limitations: This card defines a global conservation MR for the synthetic periodic-advection task only. It is not evidence for conservation on open-boundary CFD meshes, real defects, model accuracy, or production reliability.
